map.为什么非离子氨更毒？: Why is un-ionised ammonia more toxic?
map.非离子氨(NH₃)易透过鳃膜进入血液，毒性远高于离子铵(NH₄⁺)；其占比随 p: Un-ionised ammonia (NH₃) readily crosses the gill membrane into the blood and is far more toxic than the ammonium ion (NH₄⁺); its fraction rises markedly with higher pH and temperature.
map.pKa 在这里的作用？: What is the role of pKa here?
map.pKa 决定 NH₄⁺⇌NH₃+H⁺ 平衡；由 pKa 与 pH 可算出非离子氨: pKa determines the NH₄⁺ ⇌ NH₃ + H⁺ equilibrium; from pKa and pH you can compute the share of un-ionised ammonia in total ammonia, which is central to the toxicity assessment.
